draft.reply:
Hi there,

Thanks for flagging this, and sorry for the trouble. Two charges of the exact same amount ($45.00) on the exact same day for your Team plan is not expected behavior — our billing FAQ identifies this specific pattern (same amount, same day) as a billing error rather than normal proration, so I've escalated your case to our billing team for manual review rather than resolving it myself.

In the meantime, you can confirm the two charges by going to Settings > Billing > Invoices, where each charge should appear as its own line item — it'd help our team if you can note whether both show up there.

A member of our team will follow up directly to review the charges and, if a duplicate charge is confirmed, handle the correction — I'm not able to issue or promise a refund from here, as that has to go through our billing team.

Thanks for your patience while we sort this out.
